₹1 lakh Invested Once at 12% for 30 Years 💰 | Power of Compounding

After 10 years: ₹3.1 lakh
After 20 years: ₹9.6 lakh
After 30 years: ₹30 lakh

Rule of 72: at 12%, money roughly doubles every 6 years (72 ÷ 12). Time is the most powerful ingredient.
